description: A single solid radar shape with no grid and no outline, leaving only the shape and axis labels.
overview: A solid radar shape with no grid and no outline, leaving only the shape and the axis labels. Use it as a compact, decorative profile where exact values come from the tooltip.
usage: Replace `chartData`, set the axis and value keys, and rename the series in `chartConfig`. Change the shape's intensity with `fillOpacity` on `Radar`.
notes: With no grid, readers can't estimate values from the chart itself, so keep the tooltip or show the numbers elsewhere.
